messages:
andrew: Anyone else see a small spike in provisional billing after the resume/replay change? Two customers reported duplicate provisional credits when a toolcall replayed mid-stream.

maria: Yep, I saw that in the logs this morning. Looks like a race between resume replay and the toolcall provisional sampler. Snippet: 
```
INFO resume session=abc123 offset=198 replayed_tokens=200 provisional=true
INFO toolcall id=tc-77 triggered at offset=180 result_truncated=true charge_marked_provisional=true
```

sasha: Is this a reappearance of the old resume-ghost behavior or something new due to truncation+toolcall ordering?

kevin: Repro I ran: start stream -> client disconnect mid-token -> reconnect with same session id -> server replays 200 tokens, then a toolcall fires and returns truncated text. Ledger shows provisional for the 200 replayed tokens, then a separate provisional for toolcall tokens even though they overlap.

andrew: Router debug: 
```
route: primary -> fallback=true
resume_handler: replay_start=0 replay_end=200 replay_confirmed=false
toolcall-handler: prefix_end=190 provisional=true idempotency_key=none
ledger: provisional.200, provisional.30
```

ops-bot: alert: billing-provisional-spike customer=acme-team delta=+210 (react: :eyes:)

maria: My hypothesis: when a toolcall triggers during replay we mark its returned tokens provisional immediately, then later the replay completion path marks the same prefix provisional again (or fails to dedupe). The truncation makes the overlap fuzzy. Proposed short-term fix: in resume path, check for recent toolcall provisional markers and reconcile overlap before emitting a separate provisional charge.

sasha: Alternative: defer toolcall provisional marking until replay is fully applied/confirmed. Downside: increases latency for toolcall billing visibility and may break some quick-fail heuristics.

andrew: Proposed patch I can try: add resume_vs_toolcall overlap detection and a small windowed dedupe (by session id + prefix range). If overlap -> merge into single provisional entry and attach toolcall meta. I'll open a PR with a unit test for killed-mid-toolcall scenario.

maria: Also please add a console metric: provisional_charge_dup_count and an alert when rate > baseline. Add a telemetry tag: "resume_overlap" so we can query by route.

kevin: pinging billing team: @billing-bot any concerns on the reconciler side if we start merging provisional entries instead of separate ones?

billing-bot: FYI -- reconciler expects provisional entries to be idempotent; merging should be safe if you preserve original token counts and ids. Please include reconciliation hooks in the PR.

andrew: Great, i'll open PR with test + telemetry. Thanks all. (react: :thumbsup:)
